facts.item: Sep-2026 shareholding (filed in October): promoter 74.95%, FIIs 3.94%, DIIs 12.13%, public 8.98%; 1,42,570 shareholders.
Q2FY27 results and earnings call (consolidated revenue Rs2,317 cr per Screener, +19% YoY; OPM ~10%); investor presentation and call audio filed 5-Nov, transcript 12-Nov-2026.
Prabhudas Lilladher keeps Accumulate, cuts target to Rs235 from Rs259 (22x Sep-28E EPS).
GST penalty of Rs66.7 lakh imposed by an Assistant Commissioner; company to appeal.
Board approves further investment of BDT 15 crore (~Rs11.24 cr) in the Bangladesh subsidiary.
